phases.title: Stabilize boundaries and intent
phases.objective: Make repo ownership, contract rollout, and key open questions explicit before broad agent execution.
exit_criteria: Cross-repo ownership and rollout expectations are documented.
Open intent questions are either answered or assigned to owners.

phases.title: Reduce hotspot blast radius
phases.objective: Fence high-risk zones with narrow workstreams and verification before agents touch them directly.
allowed_scope: small modules adjacent to top hotspots
quality gate scripts and evidence outputs
required_evidence: targeted test evidence for hotspot files
exit_criteria: Top hotspot paths are either isolated behind tests or explicitly deferred.
Bootstrap backlog clearly marks blocked zones and safe-first slices.

phases.title: Execute bootstrap workstreams
phases.objective: Land the first safe SDP workstreams with reviewed evidence and rerun reality-pro after each slice.
exit_criteria: A follow-up reality-pro run improves readiness verdict or shrinks blocked zones.
